title: decode.rs: base64 pre-truncation yields non-multiple-of-4 length, causing false decode error
description: In decode_body_value(), the pre-truncation formula max_b64_chars = n.saturating_mul(4) / 3 + 4 produces values that are not multiples of 4 when n is not divisible by 3 (e.g., n=1 → 5, n=2 → 6, n=4 → 9, n=5 → 10). Standard base64 (STANDARD engine with padding) rejects inputs whose length is not a multiple of 4. This causes the Err arm to fire: is_encoding_problem=true and Vec::new() returned, even though the body is perfectly valid base64 and only a preview was requested. Trigger: decode_body_value with max_bytes=Some(n) where n mod 3 != 0 on a valid base64 body longer than max_b64_chars characters. Fix: round max_b64_chars up to next multiple of 4.
